_provenance.status_note: Each hazard is source_grounded (traces to methodology_idea.txt / prompt.txt / litreview Report A), but the likelihood/impact judgements are qualitative analyst ESTIMATES (the Risk Register node is synthesis, confidence medium). validation_status is therefore Inferred: the hazard is Confirmed, the probability/impact scoring is Inferred and to be re-scored once data-access, partner and TRL decisions firm up. risk_owner uses structural role tokens (FELLOW research risks; HOST data-access/operational) - identities Unresolved.

risks.title: PlanetScope cost/access not secured, weakening high-resolution coverage of small plots
risks.description: High-resolution PlanetScope imagery, valuable for small horticultural plots, may not be secured due to cost/access constraints, weakening coverage where the sub-pixel problem bites hardest.
risks.mitigation: Treat PlanetScope as an optional enhancement; build the core on open Copernicus Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2 data; resolve access early (RQ8).
risks.contingency: Deliver the diagnosis on Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2 only, documenting the resolution trade-off for small plots.

risks.title: Spatial/temporal resolution harmonisation across heterogeneous sources fails or degrades fusion
risks.description: Reconciling the differing spatial and temporal resolutions of radar, optical, soil and weather sources may fail or degrade the fusion quality.
risks.mitigation: Geospatial/time-series data platform with QC; temporal compositing; explicit resolution handling.
risks.contingency: Restrict fusion to the sources that harmonise reliably; treat problematic sources as covariates at their native resolution.
source_vault_nodes: Geospatial and Time Series Data Platform (METH-INFRA-005)

risks.title: Cloud limits optical; dense vegetation reduces SAR retrieval accuracy
risks.description: Cloud cover limits Sentinel-2 optical availability, while dense vegetation reduces Sentinel-1 SAR retrieval accuracy - the two sensors' complementary weaknesses.
risks.mitigation: Lean on Sentinel-1 SAR through cloud; cloud masking; vegetation-aware retrieval.
risks.contingency: Weight the fusion toward the more reliable sensor per condition; gap-fill optical with radar-informed estimates.

risks.title: Sparse dense ground-truth leaves validation under-powered
risks.description: Few large-scale efforts collect dense ground truth, so the validation may be under-powered to establish credibility.
risks.mitigation: Plan field trials with dense ground truth (RQ4); use a cost-effective sensor network.
risks.contingency: Prioritise ground truth at a focused pilot site; supplement with published reference datasets.
risks.note: The field sites and farms that would supply ground truth are Unresolved (spine-dependent).

risks.title: Route B patch/control-stand covariation not actually proven
risks.description: Route B's central assumption - that the chosen homogeneous patch genuinely covaries with the target crop - may not hold, invalidating the proxy.
risks.mitigation: Pre-register a covariation test; measure covariation (control stand) rather than assume it (RQ9).
risks.contingency: Fall back to Route A (direct probabilistic fusion) as the main diagnostic route if covariation cannot be demonstrated.

risks.title: Reported uncertainty is not well calibrated
risks.description: The framework's headline commitment - honest uncertainty - fails if e.g. 90% prediction intervals do not contain the truth about 90% of the time.
risks.mitigation: Build uncertainty-calibration metrics into the validation protocol (RQ5); use uncertainty-aware calibration end to end.
risks.contingency: Recalibrate posteriors post-hoc; report calibration honestly and narrow claims to the calibrated regime.

risks.title: Route A too demanding (expertise / validation data / compute)
risks.description: The rigorous one-step probabilistic fusion route may exceed available modelling expertise, validation data or compute within the fellowship.
risks.mitigation: Keep Route B as a credible fallback; stage the build; provision the probabilistic-modelling compute runtime.
risks.contingency: Adopt Route B as the primary diagnostic route, with Route A as a comparison where resources allow (RQ2).

risks.title: Overconfidence - collapsing to one parameter set instead of an honest range
risks.description: Calibrating AquaCrop to a single overconfident parameter set would break the uncertainty chain and produce falsely confident decisions.
risks.mitigation: Uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration that retains parameter uncertainty (the fellow-attributed method, doi:10.1016/j.envsoft.2022.105556).
risks.contingency: Ensemble over plausible parameter sets and propagate their spread into the decision if a full posterior is intractable.

risks.title: Sensor calibration/integration complexity
risks.description: Integrating and calibrating heterogeneous sensors (radar, optical, soil, weather) adds complexity that can degrade signal quality.
risks.mitigation: QC pipeline; sensor comparison in the validation layer.
risks.contingency: Reduce the sensor set to the reliably calibrated core; document excluded sensors as extension points.

risks.title: Prototype does not reach a usable pilot (operational-frameworks gap)
risks.description: Operational frameworks unifying all sensors at scale are scarce, so the demonstrator may not reach a usable pilot within the fellowship.
risks.mitigation: Frame the MVP as a standalone research demonstrator; partners assist (feedback, farmer access, testing) rather than own or operate it; set the TRL target explicitly (RQ10).
risks.contingency: Deliver a research-prototype TRL demonstrator with a documented path to pilot, rather than claiming operational readiness.
source_vault_nodes: Web MVP and User Interface Layer (METH-INFRA-010)
risks.note: The partners who would assist with testing/farmer access are Unresolved (AgroVIR-like only; not committed).
